response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with strong full-stack, systems, and open-source credentials, but his resume shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core focus of this role. There is also no evidence of principal-level scope such as leading multi-team initiatives, architecting systems adopted across an organization, or multi-region high-availability service ownership.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Demonstrated technical depth and initiative via founding/maintaining open-source projects (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial)
Broad language/technology versatility (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, C/C++, Java, C#) matching required core languages
concerns: No experience with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, feature flagging, or rollout risk management
No evidence of telemetry/metrics infrastructure or data-driven experimentation analysis work
No demonstrated principal-level scope: cross-team platform ownership, multi-region distributed systems at scale, or organizational technical leadership
